source_refs.note: 'Importance of Data Visualization' under topic 7.5, as printed (PDF 100-101, printed 96-97).

blocks.text: Data visualization is important because it converts raw data into meaningful visual forms. It helps researchers quickly understand large datasets that are difficult to analyze numerically. Visual tools highlight trends, distributions, and variations in data clearly. They make communication of results easier to both technical and non-technical audiences. Visualization also reduces errors by making unusual patterns visible. It supports better interpretation of statistical findings. Therefore, data visualization is an essential step in data analysis and hypothesis testing.
